title: Crystal structure and single-molecule magnet behavior of a novel tetranuclear Dy(III)-based cluster

synthesis.procedure: Dy(acac)3·2H2O (0.03 mmol, 0.0149 g), H3L (0.03 mmol, 0.0092 g), CH3OH (8.0 mL), CH3CN (4.0 mL) and CH2Cl2 (2.0 mL) were enclosed in a glass vial (v = 20 mL) and heated to 70 °C for about 48 h. The mixture was then cooled to room temperature at about 5 °C/h, giving yellow block crystals of cluster 1.
synthesis.temperature: 70 °C, then cooled to room temperature at about 5 °C/h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal synthesis in a 20 mL glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: slow cooling yielded yellow block crystals

properties.summary: Cluster 1 is a tetrahedral Dy4 SMM. χMT at 300 K is 56.83 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 56.68 for four DyIII), falling to 28.51 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K, consistent with Stark depopulation and/or antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy interactions. Zero-dc-field ac data show frequency-dependent χ′/χ″ peaks and QTM (upward tails at 2 K). Arrhenius fitting of lnτ vs T−1 under zero dc field gives Ueff/kB = 54.6 K and τ0 = 6.43 × 10−7 s. Cole–Cole plots fit a generalized Debye model with α = 0.17–0.51.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, 1000 Oe dc field, polycrystalline sample

measurements.name: Ueff/kB
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Arrhenius fit of lnτ vs T−1

measurements.name: α (Debye distribution)
measurements.conditions: Cole–Cole plots, zero dc field, generalized Debye model
